correctness.rationale: Every matrix coefficient of the explicit ray shift has propagation at most the step bound; the range omits exactly one basis vector. Consequently the shift is an index-minus-one Fredholm isometry and the compact rank-one generator is K0-trivial inside the uniform Roe algebra. Six-term exactness forces K0 quotient isomorphism and K1 split extension; standard nuclearity permanence, the stated Guo–Li–Zhang–Zhu upper bound, and nuclear-dimension-zero local AF/K1 vanishing force exact dimensions one or infinity. The infinite graph corollary follows by the locally finite infinity lemma. No numerical evidence is used to assert an infinite result.

originality.rationale: Comparisons with the full-text papers of Guo–Li–Zhang–Zhu, Braga–Farah–Vignati, Li–Willett, and Winter–Zacharias found the full-algebra upper bound, corona definition and rigidity, full-algebra K-theory, and general permanence/exact-sequence principles respectively, not the full coarse-ray corona index-and-dimension classification. The geometric rank-one defect criterion is an explicit additional hypothesis-to-invariant computation. Prior abstract indexing was also queried for formulations involving Fredholm index, K1 splitting, Roe corona, and nuclear dimension. Older implicit coarse-index statements remain a material risk.

value.rationale: The uniform Roe corona is an intrinsically motivated object in coarse operator algebra. The result detects a canonical rank-one obstruction for all bounded-step ray geometries, including every infinite connected bounded-degree graph, gives both K-group relations and a sharp dimension classification, and distinguishes the role of the new Property A dimension bound from the entirely geometric Fredholm-index invariant. No stronger paper-sized claim or numerical K-group calculation is asserted.
